mapper.insert: insert into gym.booking_record (user_id, member_course_id, schedule_id, booking_date, booking_time, status) value (#{userId},#{memberCourseId},#{scheduleId},#{bookingDate},#{bookingTime},#{status})
mapper.update: update gym.booking_record set status = #{status} where id = #{bookingRecordId}
mapper.select: SELECT schedule_id, COUNT(*) AS number FROM booking_record WHERE booking_date BETWEEN #{param.startDate} AND #{param.endDate} AND status != 3 GROUP BY schedule_id
